text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer multi-paragraph argument with examples","quality":"development","description":"It develops ideas with supporting examples and explanations rather than repeating the same point."},{"evidence":"\"I have a friend...\" and \"I have a teacher...\"","quality":"use of anecdotal support","description":"It uses personal anecdotes and illustrative details to make its claims more concrete and persuasive."},{"evidence":"\"The guitar class is very amusing and interesting\"","quality":"sentence variety","description":"It includes a wider range of sentence forms, including quoted speech and more complex sentences."},{"evidence":"\"They were kind with me so that was more easy to me to have a conversation\"","quality":"cohesive progression","description":"Its paragraphs move more clearly from one reason to the next with transitional linking and a clearer argumentative flow."},{"evidence":"\"I think a lot of what she told me and probably after I finish NOVA I'm applying to some university\"","quality":"lexical sophistication","description":"It shows somewhat more advanced word choice and academic phrasing than the other essay."}]}
